scope: Synthetic connected-node-path retargeting, both directions; no original-asset or reference framebuffer comparison in this probe.
assertions: Retarget and movement return no error
Walk completes within 200 subsequent mover updates
Final position equals requested point on node line
limitations: Does not prove unsupported movement guards unreachable. Collision, off-path, degenerate-node and immediate-exit branches need separate reproduction/reference checks; this is not full user-input or physical-device acceptance.
